pipeline.asset: HEPZATO KIT (melphalan for Injection / Hepatic Delivery System)
pipeline.modality: Drug/device combination (chemo-saturation; hepatic arterial melphalan with extracorporeal filtration)

indications.trial_name: HEPZATO + SOC vs SOC in liver-dominant mBC
indications.trial_design: Randomized, controlled, ~90 patients, >15 sites US/EU; Melphalan/HDS followed by physician's choice SOC (eribulin, vinorelbine or capecitabine) vs SOC alone
key_milestones: hPFS primary endpoint readout expected end of 2028

indications.trial_name: HEPZATO + trifluridine-tipiracil + bevacizumab vs SOC in liver-dominant mCRC
indications.trial_design: Randomized, controlled, ~90 patients, >20 sites US/EU; Melphalan/HDS followed by trifluridine-tipiracil + bevacizumab vs trifluridine-tipiracil + bevacizumab alone
key_milestones: hPFS primary endpoint readout anticipated end of 2027

HEPZATO_KIT.indication: Liver-directed treatment for adult patients with uveal melanoma (mUM) with unresectable hepatic metastases (<50% liver involvement; limited or resectable extrahepatic disease)

CHEMOSAT.approval: CE-marked / MDR certified 2022-02-28 (EU stand-alone hepatic delivery device for melphalan)
CHEMOSAT.indication: Liver-directed melphalan delivery; used at major EU centers for cancers in the liver
